MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 15
   D. 7

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 38

6. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 10

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 20

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

10. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

18. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 19

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

21. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

22. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

23. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

24. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
